code_provenance.source_scope: runtime source tree; imported/exported resources may omit original files

frame_diagnostics.frame_setup_cpu_scope: Engine-wide rendering setup CPU time, shared across viewports.
frame_diagnostics.gpu_timing_note: GPU timing may be delayed; zero is ambiguous between unavailable and zero measured time.
frame_diagnostics.render_cpu_scope: Viewport rendering CPU only; excludes script and other engine CPU.
frame_diagnostics.render_memory_note: Rendering memory values are engine estimates in bytes, not process RSS or free VRAM.
frame_diagnostics.static_memory_note: Godot static memory may be unavailable in release builds and can report zero.

measured_simulation.scope: first sampled frame end through last sampled frame end; excludes the first sampled interval

note: Frame intervals use monotonic Time.get_ticks_usec wall time; legacy seconds/fps_mean/frame_ms use that clock. Godot delta is recorded separately under engine_*. The first _process call primes the clock, excluding ready/startup. The scripted-fixed route disables input and advances its visual clock from elapsed wall time. preset=current-default reports current rendering settings; the app has no named performance presets. Software renderers such as llvmpipe are not target-hardware performance numbers.

simulation.scope: first _process clock prime through sample completion; includes warm-up
